original_content_full:
Two posters got accepted for publication at the EG Conference on Visualization (EuroVis '23).

  • Tim Cech, Furkan Simsek, Willy Scheibel, and Jürgen Döllner: "A Dashboard for Interactive Convolutional Neural Network Training And Validation Through Saliency Maps"
  • Willy Scheibel and Jürgen Döllner: "Constructing Hierarchical Continuity in Hilbert & Moore Treemaps"

The conference takes place from June 12 to 16 in Leipzig, Germany. For more information, visit the website.
